summary: xAI released version 1.15.0 of its Python SDK, adding a new grok-build-0.1 model option to ChatModel and introducing context compaction support.

practices.reason: A new model identifier was added to the SDK's ChatModel enum, which teams would need to reference to use it but requires no urgent migration.
practices.quote: Add grok-build-0.1 to ChatModel by @shawnthapa in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/155

practices.reason: Context compaction support is a memory/context-management technique but the release note gives no detail on how it works or what gain it produces.
practices.quote: Add context compaction support by @shawnthapa in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/156
